item.message: Code Mode is unavailable because code-mode host is disabled. Code mode will fail closed; enable `features.code_mode_host` and install `codex-code-mode-host`.

item.text: {"rule":"The procedure appears to always preserve the ace of clubs: after the first tap it keeps whichever pair contains it, and after the second tap it either keeps the club if tapped or discards the other card."}
